MOTOR2.ACTIVATED: Done: new conversations in its inbox are handled by this agent.

MISSING.name: Give the agent a name (in Agent).

INSTRUCTIONS.HINT: Write it as you would explain the job to a new person: tone, what to say and what not, how to handle hard cases. No codes or routes: order, limits and tools come from the skills.
INSTRUCTIONS.PLACEHOLDER: E.g.: Help parents asking about our programs…
INSTRUCTIONS.VOICE: The company's general tone is in

AGENT.NAME: Agent name (internal)
AGENT.OBJECTIVE_PH: E.g.: The student books a campus visit
AGENT.CONTEXT_PH: Who it talks to and what to know

KNOWS.SOURCES_HINT: Check where the agent looks before giving a fact. It only gives prices, links and dates found here.
KNOWS.NO_SOURCES: The account has no sources yet.
KNOWS.BUSINESS_HINT: What doesn't change: hours, address, phone, payment methods.

SKILLS.HINT: Turn on what the agent must be able to do. Each skill brings its own rules: you only fill its data.

DATA.TITLE: Questions and customer data
DATA.LINE: Asks one at a time and saves the answers.
DATA.LABEL: Data (e.g.: Program of interest)

OFFERS.TITLE: Staged offers
OFFERS.LINE: Scholarships, discounts or terms: one at a time when price is objected.
OFFERS.OBJECTION_PH: Too expensive, can't afford it, any discount?
OFFERS.STEP_PH: The offer as it can be given

APPOINTMENTS.TITLE: Appointments
APPOINTMENTS.LINE: Offers free slots and books, moves or cancels.
APPOINTMENTS.WHEN_PH: E.g.: when they want to visit

TICKETS.TITLE: Cases
TICKETS.LINE: Opens a case with its number and tells how it's going.

FILES.TITLE: Files
FILES.LINE: Sends your files when asked, with the welcome, in an attempt, when booking or opening a case.
FILES.SAVE_FIRST: Save the agent to upload files.

HANDOFF.TITLE: Hand over to a person
HANDOFF.LINE: When it leaves the chat to someone on the team, and to whom.
HANDOFF.WHEN_PH: E.g.: asks for a person or gets upset

RULES.KEYWORDS_HINT: Exact: the engine applies them instantly.
RULES.WELCOME_HINT: Sent once, at the customer's first message. If they also ask something, it answers too.

VERSIONS.SAVE_FIRST: Versions start when you save the agent.

TEST.TITLE: Test (you are the customer)
TEST.HINT: Write as a customer. Nothing is saved or sent. Use 👎 to tell the trainer what went wrong.

DECISIONS.handoff: Would hand over to a person: {text}

TRAINER.SAVE_FIRST: Save the agent's changes before correcting.
TRAINER.SHARED: ⓘ Canned responses are also used by your team and other agents.
TRAINER.EXTERNAL: This source is fixed where it lives («{name}»).
TRAINER.WHAT_WRONG: What went wrong and how should it have answered?
TRAINER.WHAT_WRONG_PH: E.g.: It gave both scholarships at once

TESTS.SAVE_FIRST: Save the agent to keep tests.
TESTS.HINT: Conversations that must go right. The trainer runs them before correcting anything.
TESTS.EMPTY: No tests yet: save a conversation from the tester or correct with 👎.

CONVERT.TITLE: Already have this agent on Engine 1.0?
CONVERT.HINT: «Move to 2.0» converts the same agent: it stays in its campaigns, follow-ups and automations, and its training is laid out in this profile. From then on Engine 2.0 answers its conversations. You can move it back anytime.
CONVERT.CONFIRM: From now on Engine 2.0 will answer its conversations. Move it?
CONVERT.DONE: Done: review the profile and test it before leaving it on.
CONVERT.BACK_CONFIRM: The agent goes back to Engine 1.0 with its usual training (the 2.0 profile stays saved). Move it back?

REAL.WHAT_WRONG: What went wrong and how should it have answered?
